title: Coverage from covsum
brief: CI moves from go tool cover to covsum, which also covers the TypeScript. check-coverage.sh reads the total from covsum --json and still fails the build below the floor.
tasks: Read the total from covsum --json in check-coverage.sh

expected.why: When covsum or jq is missing or fails, pct is empty, `[ -n "$pct" ]` skips the comparison and the script exits 0: the coverage gate passes without measuring anything.
